about_the_game:
When King Arthur falls under a mysterious spell, saving Camelot comes down to your dice, your strategy, and your nerves of steel.

A bewildering fate has fallen upon the dear King, and Queen Gwynevere must rally his faithful Knights of the Round Table. Fight your way through a Camelot that's charmingly unhinged, where medieval meets absurdity.

Master chaos on your own terms in this roguelike where Farkle-inspired combat meets deck-building depth. Every decision you make will shape your fate, and victory belongs to those bold enough to risk it all for the perfect combination.

Push-Your-Luck Combat

Dicealot transforms the classic game of Farkle into nail-biting roguelike combat. Roll your dice and look for scoring combinations that deal huge damage to enemies. In Dicealot, strategy meets chance, mastery meets madness, and every roll could be the one that changes everything. The catch? You can keep rolling to build bigger combos and rack up more points, but push too far and you'll farkle - losing everything you've earned that turn. Every roll matters and each choice could just be your last. Do you have the courage to keep rolling when the kingdom hangs in the balance?

Build Your Dice Arsenal

You’ll start each run with basic dice - visit shops in between your battles to acquire new ones and build up your set. Some dice can increase your odds of certain rolls, others multiply your scores (or might be a detriment, hope you have enough re-rolls to change that!) It’s up to you to find the perfect combinations to save King Arthur and smite his foes!

Choose from 10 distinct weapons that fundamentally change how you approach combat. Maybe you prefer consistent smaller hits, or perhaps you’d rather go all in on chasing the biggest rolls. Each combination creates a different playstyle to master and you must forge your own path to victory.

Key Features:

  • Push-your-luck Farkle combat will keep you on the edge of your seat

  • Progressive dice-building with 100+ unique dice to encounter

  • 10 distinct weapons with their own unique abilities to tweak your playstyle

  • 30+ wicked foes in a charmingly chaotic Camelot for you to take on

  • Endless replayability with 7 difficulty levels to test your mettle

  • Risk - reward gameplay where every decision matters

Ready to Roll the Dice, Test Your Luck and Save the Kingdom?

Face over 30 different enemies, each with unique dice and abilities that will test your dice-building skills and strategy. From irate maidens to mystical creatures, your journey will be challenged at every turn - will you persevere and save your King?

Push your luck, master the chaos, save Camelot.

Dicealot is inspired by other amazing games: Balatro, Monster Train, Slay the Spire, Inscryption, Dicey Dungeons and many other amazing deckbuilders.

Build legendary dice combinations, face eclectic foes, and discover if you have the nerve to keep rolling when everything's on the line. Every roll is a risk. Every risk is an adventure.
